scientific_integrity: Sharpness is proved by exact step extremizers and BV signed-measure decomposition; finite rational computation is supplemental; no external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real BV on the full line; uniform mesh; centered box widths \(0<\alpha\le2\); not a classification of arbitrary kernels or boundary treatments. Priority remains subject to unindexed earlier literature.
title: Sharp \(L^1\)–\(L^\infty\) error frontier for box-averaged hat interpolation of BV functions
